10 PRINT" BOND AMORTIZATON"
20 PRINT"  (C) 1979 CARL KADIE
30 PRINT
40 INPUT"PRICIPAL";PR
50 INPUT"INTEREST";IN

85 DIMT(6,NY),M(NY)
86 FOR AD=1 TO NY:M(AD)=-1:NEXT AD
90 OPEN1,4:OPEN2,4,1:OPEN3,4,2:OPEN4,4,4
94 PRINT#1,"YEAR         ";
